purpose: General explanatory library: a macro research corpus and a complementary retirement collection; not a schedule to reproduce source videos.

statusLegend.Reuse: Existing source or capability can be curated and reviewed.
statusLegend.Extend: Existing primitives are present; a reusable adapter, composition or workflow remains to be built.
statusLegend.New: Proposed asset or capability; not implemented by this research.

effortLegend.S: Curation or a narrow existing-primitive adaptation.
effortLegend.M: A new reusable composition/adapter with bounded variants.
effortLegend.L: A new quantitative contract, native feature or Blender rig with meaningful verification.

priorities.Now: First proof set; high reuse or unlocks several others.
priorities.Next: Build after the first proof set establishes the contracts.
priorities.Later: Specialized or expensive; wait for a concrete scene to justify it.

items.name: Shared-axis time-series comparison

items.name: Relative-performance branch chart
